DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P501..P507 = cols 52-58, identical to ES3032 lines 4-5 and to the questionnaire's column codes (52)-(58)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 3 sets item = the variable name (p501..p507; lower-casing is Stata naming, a mechanical case change of the CIS code) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P501, P502, P503, P506, P507 match the corresponding rows of the Pregunta 5 grid in cues3032.pdf character for character, 5/5 (line-break hyphenations such as 'pue-/da', 'pre-/ferible', 'acu-/dir', 'de-/berían', 'hi-/jos/as', 'sacri-/ficar' rejoined; read from a 300-dpi render of the scanned page, not OCR). P504 and P505 DIFFER IN GENDER-INCLUSIVE FORMS ONLY: the labels read 'los/as niños/as', 'los/as abuelos/as' (P504) and 'los/as niños/as', 'un/a cuidador/a extraño/a' (P505), while the printed questionnaire reads 'los niños/as', 'los abuelos' and 'los niños/as', 'un cuidador extraño'. Same statements, same column codes (55)(56), same order, so the code-to-text tie is unaffected. item_text ships the QUESTIONNAIRE wording for all 7 (what interviewers read aloud); the label variants are recorded here and not shipped. (no code 8 N.S. is defined for P.5, and DA3032 holds none), matching the questionnaire's numbered list.
